title: Two gravity inversions, sky and sea (findings of the frozen run)
label: blind

run.id: SCI-R3 first run under the frozen prereg

misses.description: the NFW fit for UGC01281 failed by the preregistered rule: its scale radius sits at the 500 kpc bound
ESO563-G021's decisive pISO fit converged but is statistically poor (reduced chi-squared 14.5; NFW 30.2)
the preregistered box rule picked boxes already crossed by later ship tracks, so the far field was unsampled; a far-field box was added post hoc (Amendment 1)

the later 'truth' grid is cell medians, possibly including gridded compilations, and the archive edits soundings that disagree with gravity; two measured versions of one cell differ by RMS up to 139 m
